date_note: Diário do Grande ABC's page, dated 26 November, says the ruling came 'nesta quinta-feira, 26'.
exec: Brazil's Supreme Court president refused to lift the pretrial detention of two men said to belong to a hacker group that served banker Daniel Vorcaro, per Diário do Grande ABC.
geo_basis: country: ruling by the president of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (STF); the page gives no city
plain: Diário do Grande ABC reports that Brazil's Supreme Court president Edson Fachin refused to release two men held over a hacker group that worked for banker Daniel Vorcaro.

sources.name: Diário do Grande ABC: Fachin mantém prisão de dois hackers do grupo que prestava serviços a Daniel Vorcaro

summary: Diário do Grande ABC reports that on Thursday 26 November Edson Fachin denied a request to revoke the pretrial detention of two men it describes as members of the hacker group 'Os Meninos', which served banker Daniel Vorcaro. The ruling says the detention 'segue adequada e indispensável à aplicação da lei penal'. The article links one of them to the third phase of Operation Compliance Zero.
title: Brazil's Fachin keeps detention of two hackers of the group that served Daniel Vorcaro, Diário do Grande ABC reports

validation.note: Only Diário do Grande ABC read; the court decision itself was not read.

review.note: Compared title, date 26 Nov, ruling wording and Compliance Zero link with Diário do Grande ABC
